units.source_text: 紫姬的回信中并不何等介怀，却写得语气非常和蔼。

en.t: In Lady Murasaki's reply, she did not seem especially troubled, and her tone was very gentle.

units.source_text: 末了写道：“承蒙不欺，以梦情见告，闻讯之下，胸中顿起无限思量。

en.t: At the end she wrote, "Thank you for not concealing the truth from me and for telling me about your dream; when I heard it, countless thoughts suddenly rose in my heart.
